title: Hover-only checkout menu
control: Checkout lives in a CSS :hover mega-menu. It is display:none until pointer hover, so it is not focusable and not in the accessibility tree.
treatment: Menu opens on focus and keyboard activation; Checkout is a real link.

title: Unlabeled icon button
control: Cart / continue control is a glyph with no accessible name.
treatment: Button has aria-label="View cart and check out".

title: Non-focusable div used as Place order
control: Place order is a clickable div with no role, tabindex, or name.

wcag: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships / 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions
title: Form fields without labels
control: Email and card fields have placeholders only, no <label> or aria-label.
treatment: Every input has a visible associated label.

title: Low-contrast terms copy
control: Terms checkbox label is grey-on-grey (~1.4:1). Low-vision persona will not agree to unread terms.
